title: Object shape guard
responsibility: Distinguishes non-null, non-array objects from scalar values.

inputs.name: isRecord.value
inputs.description: Value to classify before treating it as a record. Any JavaScript value is accepted; only non-null objects that are not arrays return true.
inputs.unknownReason: The type guard accepts any value and tests whether it is a non-null non-array object.

outputs.name: isRecord
outputs.description: Boolean result used to decide whether to treat the input as a record. It is true exactly for non-null values whose JavaScript type is object and that are not arrays; the predicate does not inspect properties or require a plain-object prototype.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown if value is a revoked Proxy, because Array.isArray(value) throws while testing it.
